# Diagnostics baseline: gtfparser vs real tf

Generated by `scripts/warn_baseline.py` from `scripts/warncheck.py --json` (engine commit `253e383`). 
Regenerate: `go build -o /tmp/warn_gtfrun ./cmd/gtfrun && . scripts/env.sh && python3 scripts/warncheck.py --json /tmp/w.json --no-gate && python3 scripts/warn_baseline.py /tmp/w.json > testdata/warnings/BASELINE.md`.

## Summary

- catalog: **439** entries, **257** testable, 182 untestable
- cases run: **257**
- status: `missing` 107, `context` 85, `body+context` 45, `body+context+missing` 7, `context+missing` 5, `body` 3, `OK` 3, `body+context+extra` 2
- mismatch classes (a case can have several): body 57, context 144, missing in gtfparser 119, extra in gtfparser 2
- body-only comparison (`--ignore-context`): **88 of 257** cases already match exactly
- real tf crashed in: none. (Earlier probing found that real tf of this build crashes with signal 11 after printing `division by zero` inside a macro; that case is `expr.813` run at file level, so it is unaffected.)

## Context prefix format

Real tf prefixes errors with `% [<file>, line N: ][<command>[ -<opt>]: ]` (`eprefix()` in tfio.c). 
`<file>` is the file being `/load`ed, `lines N-M` for a backslash-continued command; `<command>` is the *innermost* 
running thing: the builtin's upper-case name (`DEF`, `EVAL`, `UNDEF`; `/test` and bare expressions show none), a macro's name, 
a function's name (`mod: `), or `#N` for an unnamed macro. Typed at the prompt there is no file part. Warnings add `Warning: ` after it. 
gtfparser prints `/test: msg` / `/load: msg` (slash plus lower-case command name, never a location, never a macro name).

| case | real tf | gtfparser |
|---|---|---|
| ctx.file-line | `<FILE>, line 3: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.macro | `<FILE>, line 2: f: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.macro-nested | `<FILE>, line 3: inner: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.multiline | `<FILE>, lines 2-3: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.eval | `<FILE>, line 1: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.trigger | `<FILE>, line 2: trg: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.hook | `<FILE>, line 2: zzz: no such command or macro \| <FILE>, line 2: #751: nofunc: no such function` | `zzz: no such command or macro \| /test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.load-nested | `Loading commands from <DIR>/sub/inner.tf. \| <DIR>/sub/inner.tf, line 2: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.option-suffix | `<FILE>, line 1: DEF -Z: invalid option \| <FILE>, line 1: DEF: options: -p<integer> -c<integer> -b<string> ...` | `DEF -Z: invalid option \| DEF: options: -p<integer> -c<integer> -b<string> -B<string> -E<string> -t<string>...` |
| ctx.function-name | `<FILE>, line 1: mod: real value too large to convert to integer` | `-` |
| ctx.builtin-in-macro | `<FILE>, line 2: UNDEF: Macro "nope" was not defined.` | `UNDEF: Macro "nope" was not defined.` |
| ctx.nonexistent-command | `<FILE>, line 1: nosuchcommand: no such command or macro` | `nosuchcommand: no such command or macro` |
| ctx.nonexistent-in-macro | `<FILE>, line 2: h: nosuchcommand: no such command or macro` | `nosuchcommand: no such command or macro` |
| ctx.typed | `nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.typed-macro | `f: nofunc: no such function` | `/test: nofunc: no such function` |
| ctx.typed-builtin | `UNDEF: Macro "nosuchmacro" was not defined.` | `UNDEF: Macro "nosuchmacro" was not defined.` |
| ctx.typed-option | `DEF -Z: invalid option \| DEF: options: -p<integer> -c<integer> -b<string> -B<string> -E<string> -t<string>...` | `DEF -Z: invalid option \| DEF: options: -p<integer> -c<integer> -b<string> -B<string> -E<string> -t<string>...` |

## Top 15 mismatches

1. `ctx.file-line`: every diagnostic lacks the `<file>, line N: ` location and prints `/test:` where tf prints no command name at all
2. `ctx.macro`: inside a macro tf names the macro (`f: `); gtfparser prints the command (`/test: `)
3. `ctx.macro-nested`: tf names only the innermost macro (`inner: `), never a chain
4. `command.576`: `/load` of a missing file: tf `LOAD: <path>: No such file or directory`, gtfparser `/load: <path>: no such file`
5. `expr.2015`: builtin function arity: `strlen: found 0 arguments, expected 1` vs `strlen(): too few arguments`
6. `expr.2090`: expression syntax errors: `expression syntax error: expected operand, found end of body.` vs `expression: unexpected end` (all expression parse errors differ)
7. `expr.1757`: unknown function: only the context differs, the body already matches
8. `expand.1300`: misplaced /done /endif etc. in a macro: `unexpected /DONE in IF body` vs `/done without matching /if or /while`
9. `expand.1469`: unterminated /if in a macro: tf `macro syntax error: expected /endif, found end of body.`, gtfparser silent
10. `expand.1390`: unterminated /while: tf reports a syntax error, gtfparser runs the loop until `max_instr`
11. `expand.1303`: `/while (1) /endif` makes gtfparser print the same error on every iteration (1M lines in the harness)
12. `socket.3052`: text sent with no connection: tf prints `Not connected.`, gtfparser prints nothing
13. `variable.609`: `/set foo =bar` warning `'=' following space is part of value.` missing (and variable.358/300/657/730/745 etc.)
14. `command.648`: file load diagnostics (`Invalid command. Aborting.`, trailing backslash, `Loading commands from`) missing
15. `expr.1089`: file functions fail silently or with `not supported by this client` (tfopen/tfread/tfwrite/fwrite errors)
